elements.name: Aarakocra
elements.desc: A winged people who originated on the Elemental Plane of Air, aarakocra soar through the sky wherever they wander.

elements.name: Aasimar
elements.desc: Aasimar are placed in the world to serve as guardians of law and good.

elements.name: Bugbear
elements.desc: Bugbears are born for battle and mayhem.

elements.name: Centaur
elements.desc: Centaurs gallop into the fray, their hooves thundering across the battlefield.

elements.name: Changeling
elements.desc: Changelings are shapechangers by nature, capable of altering their appearance at will.

elements.name: Deep Gnome
elements.desc: Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are natives of the Underdark and are suffused with that subterranean realm's magic.

elements.name: Duergar
elements.desc: Duergar are dwarves whose ancestors were transformed by centuries living in the deepest places of the Underdark.

elements.name: Eladrin
elements.desc: Eladrin are elves of the Feywild, a realm of perilous beauty and boundless magic.

elements.name: Fairy
elements.desc: The Feywild is home to many fantastic peoples, including fairies.

elements.name: Firbolg
elements.desc: Firbolgs are humanoids related to giants, with a connection to the natural world.

rules.grant: Racial Trait:Speech of Beast and Leaf

elements.name: Air Genasi
elements.desc: Tracing their ancestry to djinn of the Elemental Plane of Air, air genasi are often restless and dream of far-off places.

elements.name: Earth Genasi
elements.desc: Tracing their ancestry to dao, the genies of the Elemental Plane of Earth, earth genasi inherit dao's steadfast strength.

elements.name: Fire Genasi
elements.desc: Tracing their ancestry to efreeti of the Elemental Plane of Fire, fire genasi are passionate and quick to act.

elements.name: Water Genasi
elements.desc: Tracing their ancestry to marids of the Elemental Plane of Water, water genasi are calm and contemplative.

elements.name: Githyanki
elements.desc: Githyanki are a lanky people with skin tones of yellows, greens, and browns.

elements.name: Githzerai
elements.desc: Githzerai are generally slender, with speckled skin in shades of yellow, green, or brown.

elements.name: Goblin
elements.desc: Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in despoiled dungeons and other dismal settings.

elements.name: Goliath
elements.desc: Distantly related to giants and infused with the supernatural essence of their ancestors' mountainous home.

elements.name: Harengon
elements.desc: Harengons originated in the Feywild, where they spoke Sylvan and embodied the spirit of freedom and travel.

elements.name: Hobgoblin
elements.desc: Hobgoblins are a goblinoid people who value discipline, honor, and community.

elements.name: Kenku
elements.desc: Feathered folk who resemble ravens, kenku are blessed with keen observation and supernaturally accurate memories.

elements.name: Kobold
elements.desc: Some of the smallest draconic creatures in the multiverse, kobolds display their draconic ancestry in the glint of their scales.

elements.name: Lizardfolk
elements.desc: The saurian lizardfolk are thought by some sages to be distant cousins of dragonborn and kobolds.

elements.name: Minotaur
elements.desc: Minotaurs are barrel-chested humanoids with heads resembling those of bulls.

elements.name: Orc
elements.desc: Orcs are a people of gray skin, sharply pointed ears, and prominent lower canines that resemble small tusks.

elements.name: Satyr
elements.desc: Originating in the Feywild—a realm of pure emotion—satyrs thrive on the energy of merriment.

elements.name: Sea Elf
elements.desc: Sea elves fell in love with the wild beauty of the ocean in the earliest days of the multiverse.

elements.name: Shadar-kai
elements.desc: Shadar-kai are the elves of the Shadowfell, originally drawn to that dread realm by the Raven Queen.

rules.grant: Racial Trait:Blessing of the Raven Queen

elements.name: Shifter
elements.desc: Shifters—sometimes called "weretouched"—descend from people who contracted full or partial lycanthropy.

elements.name: Tabaxi
elements.desc: Hailing from a strange and distant land, wandering tabaxi are catlike humanoids driven by curiosity.

elements.name: Tortle
elements.desc: Tortles have a saying: "We wear our homes on our backs."

elements.name: Triton
elements.desc: Originally from the Elemental Plane of Water, many tritons entered the Material Plane centuries ago.

elements.name: Yuan-ti
elements.desc: Yuan-ti were originally humans who transformed themselves into serpent folk through ancient rituals.

elements.name: Adrenaline Rush
elements.desc: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Whenever you use this trait, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

elements.name: Amphibious
elements.desc: You can breathe air and water.

elements.name: Astral Knowledge
elements.desc: You can mystically access a reservoir of experiences of your kind. Whenever you finish a long rest, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice. These proficiencies last until the end of your next long rest.

elements.name: Bestial Instincts
elements.desc: Channeling the beast within, you have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation, or Survival.

elements.name: Bite
elements.desc: You have a fanged maw that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.id: Racial Trait:Blessing of the Raven Queen
elements.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

elements.name: Call to the Wave
elements.desc: You know the Acid Splash cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Create or Destroy Water spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Water Walk spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast Create or Destroy Water or Water Walk with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

elements.name: Celestial Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

elements.name: Celestial Revelation
elements.desc: When you reach 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to unleash the celestial energy within yourself, gaining the benefits of that revelation. Choose one of the following options: Necrotic Shroud, Radiant Soul, or Radiant Consumption. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Changeling Instincts
elements.desc: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

elements.name: Charge
elements.desc: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

elements.name: Child of the Sea
elements.desc: You can breathe air and water, and you have resistance to cold damage.

elements.name: Control Air and Water
elements.desc: You can cast the Fog Cloud spell with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast the Gust of Wind spell with it. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

elements.name: Draconic Cry
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you let out a cry at your enemies that echoes with draconic might. Until the start of your next turn, you and your allies have advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 10 feet of you that can hear you. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Duergar Magic
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Enlarge/Reduce spell (the enlarge option only) with this trait, without requiring a material component. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Invisibility spell with it, without requiring a material component. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

elements.name: Dwarven Resilience
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the poisoned condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

elements.name: Earth Walk
elements.desc: You can move across difficult terrain without expending extra movement if you are using your walking speed on the ground or a floor.

elements.name: Emissary of the Sea
elements.desc: Aquatic animals have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

elements.name: Equine Build
elements.desc: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

elements.name: Expert Duplication
elements.desc: When you copy writing or craftwork produced by yourself or others, you can produce an exact duplicate of the original in half the normal time.

elements.name: Fairy Magic
elements.desc: You know the Druidcraft cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Faerie Fire spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Enlarge/Reduce spell with this trait. Once you cast Faerie Fire or Enlarge/Reduce with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

elements.name: Feline Agility
elements.desc: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

elements.name: Fey Ancestry
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

elements.name: Fey Step
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. When you reach 3rd level, your Fey Step gains an additional effect based on your season.

elements.name: Firbolg Magic
elements.desc: You can cast the Detect Magic and Disguise Self spells with this trait. When you use this version of Disguise Self, you can seem up to 3 feet shorter or taller. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Flight (Aarakocra)
elements.desc: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

elements.name: Flight (Fairy)
elements.desc: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

elements.name: Fortune from the Many
elements.desc: If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can draw on the bonds of solidarity to fuel your effort. Roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, potentially turning the miss or failure into a success. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Friend of the Sea
elements.desc: Aquatic animals have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

elements.name: Fury of the Small
elements.desc: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you can use it no more than once per turn.

elements.name: Githyanki Psionics
elements.desc: You know the Mage Hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Jump spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Misty Step spell with this trait. Once you cast Jump or Misty Step with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Githzerai Psionics
elements.desc: You know the Mage Hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Shield spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Detect Thoughts spell with this trait. Once you cast Shield or Detect Thoughts with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Gnomish Magic Resistance
elements.desc: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells.

elements.name: Goring Rush
elements.desc: Immediately after you take the Dash action on your turn, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action.

elements.name: Guardian of the Depths
elements.desc: Adapted to even the most extreme ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage, and you ignore any of the drawbacks caused by a deep, underwater environment.

elements.name: Hammering Horns
elements.desc: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to shove that creature with your horns. The target must be no more than one size larger than you and within 5 feet of you. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier, you push it up to 10 feet away from you.

elements.name: Hare-Trigger
elements.desc: You can add your proficiency bonus to your initiative rolls.

elements.name: Healing Hands
elements.desc: As an action, you can touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. The creature regains a number of hit points equal to the total rolled. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Hidden Step
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Hold Breath
elements.desc: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time. (Tortles can hold their breath for up to 1 hour).

elements.name: Hooves
elements.desc: You have hooves that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Horns
elements.desc: You have horns that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Hungry Jaws
elements.desc: You can throw yourself into a feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Kenku Recall
elements.desc: Thanks to your supernaturally accurate memory, you have proficiency in two skills of your choice. In addition, when you make an ability check using a skill you're proficient in, you can give yourself advantage on the check. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Kobold Legacy
elements.desc: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one of the following legacy options: Craftiness (proficiency in Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Sleight of Hand, or Survival), Defiance (advantage on saving throws against being frightened), or Draconic Sorcery (know one cantrip of your choice from the Sorcerer spell list).

elements.name: Labyrinthine Recall
elements.desc: You always know which direction is north, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Survival) check you make to navigate or track.

elements.name: Leporine Senses
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

elements.name: Light Bearer
elements.desc: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

elements.name: Little Giant
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill, and you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

elements.name: Long-Limbed
elements.desc: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

elements.name: Lucky Footwork
elements.desc: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a d4 and add it to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can't use this reaction if you're prone or your speed is 0.

elements.name: Mental Discipline
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed and frightened conditions on yourself.

elements.name: Merge with Stone
elements.desc: You know the Blade Ward cantrip. You can cast it as normal, and you can also cast it as a bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Starting at 5th level, you can cast the Pass without Trace spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast Pass without Trace with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Mimicry
elements.desc: You can accurately mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations only with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

elements.name: Mingle with the Wind
elements.desc: You know the Shocking Grasp cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Feather Fall spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Levitate spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast Feather Fall or Levitate with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Mirthful Leaps
elements.desc: Whenever you make a long jump or a high jump, you can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when you make a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

elements.name: Mountain Born
elements.desc: You have resistance to cold damage. You also naturally acclimate to high altitudes, even if you've never been to one. This includes elevations above 20,000 feet.

elements.name: Natural Affinity
elements.desc: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

elements.name: Natural Armor (Lizardfolk)
elements.desc: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

elements.name: Natural Armor (Tortle)
elements.desc: Your shell provides you a base AC of 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can't wear light, medium, or heavy armor, but if you are using a shield, you can apply the shield's bonus as normal.

elements.name: Nature's Intuition
elements.desc: Thanks to your mystical connection to nature, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

elements.name: Necrotic Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

elements.name: Nimble Escape
elements.desc: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

elements.name: Poison Resilience
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the poisoned condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

elements.name: Powerful Build
elements.desc: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

elements.name: Psionic Fortitude
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed or stunned condition on yourself.

elements.name: Psychic Resilience
elements.desc: You have resistance to psychic damage.

elements.name: Rabbit Hop
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Ram
elements.desc: You can use your head and horns to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Reach to the Blaze
elements.desc: You know the Produce Flame cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Burning Hands spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Flame Blade spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast Burning Hands or Flame Blade with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Relentless Endurance
elements.desc: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Reveler
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Performance and Persuasion skills, and you have proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

elements.name: Saving Face
elements.desc: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to expend one use of your Fortune from the Many trait to add the number rolled to the saving throw, potentially turning the failure into a success.

elements.name: Serpentine Spellcasting
elements.desc: You know the Poison Spray cantrip. You can cast Animal Friendship an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast Suggestion with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Shapechanger
elements.desc: As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex. You can also adjust your height and weight and can change your size between Medium and Small. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your game statistics change. You can stay in the new form until you use an action to revert to your true form or until you die.

elements.name: Shell Defense
elements.desc: You can withdraw into your shell as an action. Until you emerge, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in your shell, you are prone, your speed is 0 and can't increase, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, you can't take reactions, and the only action you can take is a bonus action to emerge from your shell.

elements.name: Shifting
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute. When you shift, you gain temporary hit points equal to 2 × your proficiency bonus. You can shift a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Sneaky
elements.desc: You are proficient in the Stealth skill. In addition, without squeezing, you can move through and stop in a space large enough for a Small creature.

elements.id: Racial Trait:Speech of Beast and Leaf
elements.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
elements.desc: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with beasts and plants. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

elements.name: Stone's Endurance
elements.desc: You can supernaturally draw on unyielding stone to shrug off harm. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Superior Darkvision
elements.desc: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

elements.name: Surprise Attack
elements.desc: If you hit a creature with an attack roll, the creature takes an extra 2d6 damage if it hasn't taken a turn yet in the current combat.

elements.name: Svirfneblin Camouflage
elements.desc: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can make the check with advantage. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Talons
elements.desc: You have talons that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Unending Breath
elements.desc: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you're not incapacitated.

elements.name: Wind Caller
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Gust of Wind spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast the spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher.
